dataList.content:
Heathcliff was digging through the deceased Dead Rabbits' pockets.
希斯克利夫正在死兔帮成员的口袋里翻找着。
dataList.place:
Wuthering Heights Corridors
呼啸山庄 走廊

dataList.content:
<What are you looking for, Heathcliff?>
<你在找什么，希斯克利夫？>

They don't have 'em.
他们身上没有。

<The timepieces that Yi Sang mentioned earlier?>
<李箱之前提到过的那个……钟表？>

Yeah. Everyone born and raised in T Corp. carries a watch. They have to.
是啊。在T公司辖区出生并长大的每个人一定都随身带着一块钟表。

Right... the Kurokumo Clan officer we fought in Yong-jin building was looking for a timepiece, too.
这么说来……我们在龙进大楼对付过的那个黑云会高层也寻找过类似的东西。

It's... like a form of personal identification. It's something you carry around to show others that you are who you are.
那是因为……这是证明个人身份的道具。

I abandoned my watch when I left T Corp., but...
我离开T公司时，钟表也一并扔掉了，但是……

I see... They don't even have their pocket watch chains with them.
确实如此……这些人连表链都没有。

If they did carry a watch, we would have been able to learn at least where they were coming from.
如果他们带着钟表，我们至少可以知道他们是从哪里来的。

So someone either doesn't want people finding out who they are... or they're simply not from around here. Right?
所以要么是某些人不想让别人知道他们是谁……要么他们根本不是这里的人，对吗？

I have witnessed such garb commonly worn about within the T Corp. territory. I have no doubts that they must be locals...
我曾在T公司的地盘上见过这样的装束。我敢肯定他们一定是本地人……

There are many unanswered questions... but let us save that discussion for later.
有太多悬而未决的问题了……但是这些先留到以后再讨论吧。

... Here it is.
……在这里啊。

Whew... Now that was quite the journey, wasn't it? Shall we enter?
回房间的路从来没感觉有像今天这么艰难过。呼……那我们进去吧？

... Nelly. Tell me.
……告诉我，耐莉。

After I... left without a word... how did Catherine fare?
在我……不辞而别之后……凯瑟琳的情况如何？

Of course, I already know that she lived happily ever after with that sod, Linton. But...
当然……她最后嫁给了那个混蛋林顿……我知道她过得很幸福。但……

Are you sure you want to know?
你确定你要知道吗？

Dammit, I do. But... I also don't.
妈的……我想知道，但是我又不想知道。

I must look so... pathetic. If Cathy was here, she would've mocked me mercilessly.
我看起来一定……很可悲。如果凯茜在这里，她一定会毫不留情地嘲笑我吧。

I would have brought you a mirror so you can see that priceless look on your face...
如果有面镜子的话，真想拿来让你看看自己现在的表情呢。

... if I hadn't removed them all from the premises... Ha ha.
可惜我把它们都处理掉，现在一个也不剩了……哈哈。

Tsk, I'm not interested in your stupid jests.
啧，我对你这些无聊的笑话不感兴趣。

But has Catherine ever, even once, talked about me at all since I left?
说起来……自从我走后，凯瑟琳有提过我的名字吗……哪怕是只有一次？

Of course she didn’t. A witless brigand, a scoundrel like me… I’m sure it didn’t matter to Catherine whether I—
嗯，确实如此。像我这种混蛋……不管是去是留，对凯瑟琳来说都……

I wouldn't be so sure, Heathcliff.
那个啊，希斯克利夫。

That is not what I meant.
我不是那个意思。

When you left, Miss Catherine… she began withering away. She skulked in her room for days upon days, refusing to eat or even speak.
你离开之后，凯瑟琳小姐……就开始缓慢地死去。她一连几天躲在自己的房间里，不吃东西、也不说话。

Then she’d suddenly grow lachrymose, scream, cry, whisper things to herself… Master Linton would come by to coax her, but it hardly helped matters.
然后她会尖叫、哭泣、自言自语……林顿家主会来安抚她，但也无济于事。

She was so ill that I was worried that we might have to start making arrangements with a mortician in advance.
小姐病得太重了……我都怕是要提前找殡仪馆预约了……

Really? I... Catherine… she was in that much pain?
真的吗？凯瑟琳……有那么痛苦的吗？

Heathcliff asked, incredulously.
希斯克利夫难以置信地问道。

Yes. It pained us to even watch her suffer. And one day, she…
是的。看着她在受苦，我们也感同身受。直到有一天，她……

Nelly, look. Linton’s left a flower on my pillow.
耐莉，看。林顿在我的枕边留了一朵花。

Oh, it’s golden. I didn’t know that spring had come to Wuthering Heights already. I suppose the snow has all but thawed, too.
金色的花。我都不知道，呼啸山庄也迎来了春天。雪也应该化了吧。

Is that not so romantic of him, miss?
哇，真的很浪漫啊？

I suppose it could appear that way. He must have paid quite the fortune for this.
我想应该是这样的。他一定为这个花了不少钱。

But if Linton truly cared for me, truly wished to return a color to a flower for my sake...
可是，如果林顿真是为了我而给花附上颜色……

... then he should have brought me a violet flower.
……那他应该给我带来一朵紫色的花。

So... he did not bring this flower for my sake. This was only for his own satisfaction.
所以……他不是为了我而带来这朵花的。林顿只是想满足他自己罢了。

Are you... okay, Miss?
小姐……你还好吗？

Whatever do you mean? I have never felt better than I do today.
你这是说什么呢？我从来没有像今天这样好过。

Walk with me, won't you? I would like to see which flowers have weathered the wintery cold and bloomed.
和我一起散散步，好吗？我想仔细看看，有哪些花儿熬过了冬天的寒冷并绽放了。

After that day, Miss Catherine truly appeared convalescent.
从那天往后，凯瑟琳小姐确实打起精神来了。

We were all happy to see Miss Catherine be herself again, but...
看到凯瑟琳小姐恢复正常我们都很高兴，但是……

... now that I think about it, it was a tad strange. She suffered for months upon months from fever; how could anyone so suddenly recover from all that after a single night's repose?
现在回想起来，总觉得有些不对劲。她一连受了几个月的高烧折磨。这样的一个人怎么可能一夜之间就痊愈了呢？

That is also when she purchased Wuthering Heights from Mister Hindley Earnshaw...
也就是那时，她从亨德利先生手里买下了呼啸山庄……

... and started making sweeping modifications to this place.
彻底地改造这个地方……应该也是从那时候开始的。

I thought the two of them had intended to return to Wuthering Heights, so I asked them what exactly they planned to do with it… but they never gave me a straight answer.
我以为他们俩是打算回呼啸山庄生活的，出于好奇我询问过数次……但是他们从未告诉过我要怎么改造宅邸。

Haah. I'm just as in the dark as you are. I've not the slightest clue as to what she was thinking...
哈啊。我也和你一样被蒙在鼓里，希斯克利夫。小姐到底在想些什么……

What about... my letters?
信……

I sent her letters. I haven't been able to since I joined this company, but... when I was a part of that gang...
我曾经给她寄过信。自从加入这家公司以来，我一直没能找到机会，但是……当我还是黑帮的一份子的时候……

... I wrote her letters. Though I didn't sign my name on 'em.
虽然我没在信封上面署名……

I... just wanted to let her know that I was doing fine.
我……我只是想让她知道我过得很好。

Well, I don't recall her ever opening a letter.
好吧，我记得她甚至都没开封看过。

Seriously, once she has her mind set on something, no one could convince her otherwise. No one...
一旦她下定决心，就没有人能动摇她。没有人……
